verses.12:85: قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَؤُاْ تَذۡكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوۡ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَٰلِكِينَ

meaning: The root فتأ (ftA) in its fourth form (أَفْتَاَ) refers back to earlier definitions. It implies a sense of weakness, languor, or becoming feeble, often in health or spirit.
